scripts.preinstall: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('package-lock.json') && require('fs').unlinkSync('package-lock.json'); require('fs').existsSync('yarn.lock') && require('fs').unlinkSync('yarn.lock'); if (!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.includes('pnpm')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:backend
scripts.build:frontend: cross-env PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/fresher-resume run build
scripts.build:all: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter "!@workspace/mockup-sandbox" --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev: dotenv -- concurrently "pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start" "cross-env PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/fresher-resume run dev"
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/fresher-resume run dev
